summary: Complete initial independent Chinese source-date audit of all 177 units, 149 temporal or active-hint items, and 60 people in the clean canonical Jinshi 131 extraction. All explicit regnal-year and sequence-based event conversions were checked. Forty-three active-date hints improperly turn reign, dynasty, retrospective, or broad event contexts into continuous personal activity ranges, and Wang Xuan’s 正大初 attestation falsely assigns AD 1224 as a point year. No extraction data was changed.
